name: Acolyte Lockson

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: Lockson may use Ruin Actions, and has 1 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Augmetic Eye
bonuses.text: Lockson ignores any penalties due to visual distance, obscured sight, or darkness.

bonuses.name: Deductive
bonuses.text: Lockson has the Deductive Talent (page 132 of the Wrath & Glory Rulebook).

abilities.name: Inquisitorial Decree
abilities.text: Lockson invokes the name of his superior, Inquisitor Argyle. He gains +2 bonus dice to any social Skill Test when interacting with an individual with the IMPERIUM Keyword. Lockson can only use this ability once per scene.

abilities.name: Cracking the Case
abilities.text: When the Agents fail on a social Test against Lockson, the GM gains 1 point of Ruin.

note: No Tier row printed; class proposed (Champion with 1 personal Ruin, 5 Wounds, an NPC; a Champion under 7 Wounds is E, as Bloody Gates' Cravax).
